title: How Noise-Cancelling Headphones Silence the World

segments.text: Your headphones can cancel noise by making more sound.
A tiny microphone listens to the world around you.
Then the earbuds create the exact opposite sound wave.
When the two waves meet, they erase each other.
So silence is really two sounds canceling out.
